newsitem.title: USA: Host Marriott says board OKs stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Host Marriott says board OKs stock buyback.

text.p: Host Marriott Services Corp said Tuesday its board of directors authorized the repurchase of up to $15 million of the company's common stock on the open market.
It said the shares may be used for employee stock ownership plans or for general corporate purposes, including acquisitions.
The company expects to fund the repurchase program with available cash and does not anticipate any change in its expansion plans. The program is authorized for up to 24 months.
Host Marriott is a major food, beverage and retail concessionaire at nearly 200 travel and entertainment venues, with more than 23,000 employees in five countries around the globe.
